findings.issue: センス means (aesthetic/fashion) sense, taste — not 'common sense' (常識). lit_en contradicts both the jp and the natural en ('fashion sense') and teaches a wrong equivalence.
findings.current: There is absolutely no common sense (subject), you know.
findings.suggested: There is absolutely no sense (of style) (subject), you know.

findings.issue: Parenthetical '(to become)' is wrong: する in 〜くする means 'to make/act', never 'to become' (that is なる). In the very lesson contrasting くする/くなる this gloss teaches the opposite.
Parenthetical '(tornar-se)' is wrong: する = 'fazer/agir', nunca 'tornar-se' (isso é なる). Misleads on the exact くする vs くなる contrast.
The 'quanto a' topic device is attached to the wrong word: は marks 私, not 出席 (出席できなかった is one compound predicate with no particle). Mirror misteaches which element is topicalized.
findings.current: Por ser uma razão desse tipo, eu, quanto à presença, não consegui (foi por isso).
findings.suggested: Por ser uma razão desse tipo, eu quanto-a, comparecer não consegui (foi por isso).

findings.issue: 'as for' (the は device) is placed on 出席 instead of 私は; 出席 carries no topic particle (出席できなかった is a compound potential). Structural mirror misassigns the topic.
findings.current: Because it's a reason of that kind, I, as for attendance, couldn't (that's why).
findings.suggested: Because it's a reason of that kind, as for me, attendance (I) could-not-do (that's why).

findings.issue: Duplicated word: '(o alvo alvo)' — editing artifact; expl_en has no counterpart wording.
findings.current: A partícula けど (o alvo alvo) no fim deixa a frase em aberto
findings.suggested: A partícula けど (o alvo) no fim deixa a frase em aberto
